name: SillyTavern
ontology_notes: Prompt assembler, not a memory engine. Always-on character card fields (description, personality, scenario, example messages) plus persona description and Author's Note. Keyword World Info, vector chat/file/WI matching, and a rolling chat summary are optional extensions. No typed relationship-state table. Stores are files under the user data directory.

ontology.evidence: Docs split Character Design, Personas, Author's Note, World Info, Data Bank, Vector Storage, and Summarize. Those are prompt slots and files, not typed kinds such as relationship_state. public/scripts/world-info.js, extensions/vectors/index.js, extensions/memory/index.js.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: User writes card fields, WI entries, Data Bank files, and the summary box. Summarize can LLM-extract a rolling summary into chat[i].extra.memory via setMemoryContext in extensions/memory/index.js. Vectors embed on send. No background deriver of relationship facts.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: Each turn checkWorldInfo (world-info.js) keyword/regex/timed/vector-forced entries, rearrangeChat (vectors/index.js) top-k message shuffle, setExtensionPrompt for summary. Always-on card/persona/AN. Retrieval can inject nothing if no keys match, vectors disabled, or summary empty.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: New WI entries stack. Summarize overwrites the current summary string in message extra and Restore Previous rolls back one step. Vectors keep both original messages. No invalidate-with-time for facts.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: World Info Timed Effects (sticky/cooldown/delay) count messages, not calendar time (docs/usage/worldinfo.md, WorldInfoTimedEffects in world-info.js). Chat vectorization has no date query. Summarize is a blob with no validity window.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Separate stores: character card, persona description (docs/usage/personas.md), chat lore, character lore, global WI. Relationship is still untyped prose inside those strings. No relationship_state object.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: User can omit keys, disable entries, set Probability 0, Character Filter, score_threshold for vectors, pause Summarize. No trauma/kink/spoiler type that suppresses a relevant hit. WI docs advertise random Elder-God injection via trigger%.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Injected WI/vector/summary text is trusted prompt. No provenance or trust tags. Function-calling docs list memory tools as an example pattern, not a filter (docs/for_contributors/function-calling.md).
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: User deletes/disables WI, Purge Vectors, edits or Restore Previous on summary, or deletes chat messages (summary attached to a message reverts if that message is deleted). No 'forget that' that tombstones a fact across stores.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: WI is local scan plus token budget (world_info_budget default 25% of maxContext, optional world_info_budget_cap) in checkWorldInfo. Vectors: embedding calls per new message plus optional Main API summarize-before-embed. Summarize: extra LLM call every N messages/words. All three reserve prompt tokens before chat history fits.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: AGPL-3.0 local Node server. Chat, WI, Vectra JSON under user-data /vectors. Can use local Transformers/Ollama/llama.cpp embeddings and a local LLM. Cloud APIs optional.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: No official MCP memory server. Function calling exists for Chat Completions (docs/for_contributors/function-calling.md). Built-in tools are image, web search, RSS, weather, dice, not a memory graph.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Best-in-class local roleplay prompt control and keyword lore, but it assumes retrieved or always-on text is remembering. No typed relationship state, no poisoning filter, and the official vector docs deny a memory guarantee.
open_unknowns: Whether any third-party ST extension implements typed relationship state (out of slice unless discovered).
Exact default loreBookToken in a fresh ST install vs user-tuned budgets.
